intro.text: An unarmed guard at Mercystar's palace, dressed in the colours of her household, whose job is to keep people out in the evening.

items.text: Fran and Gagaril are on duty when an apparent madman wanders in, and they kindly offer to find him somewhere to sleep for the night. The man, Vasher, takes them by surprise and knocks Fran out. When Lightsong questions the guards, Fran, bruised on his stomach and neck, describes both Vasher and his sword.
